highlights.title: The restart note says when restarts repeat
highlights.line: When this computer has restarted at least 3 times in a week while Kosmos was running, the restart note says so, with the dates.

highlights.title: Windows agents keep their account at login
highlights.line: On Windows, an agent whose startup job is put back by Start at login keeps the account and model it had, not the main account.

highlights.title: Start at login stops misreading the account
highlights.line: On Windows, Start at login no longer says an agent's account signed out or changed when it is still the same account.

highlights.title: A removed startup job explains its folder
highlights.line: On Windows, removing an agent's startup job says plainly what Start at login will do with its account folder.

highlights.title: A warning before an agent runs twice
highlights.line: Adding an agent that another login job also starts now warns first and names that job.
